root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `UA_free(dst->data)` runs on the nested-body decode error path, `Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject()` must clear `dst->data` before the partially built Variant reaches generic cleanup. Otherwise later `Variant_clear()` reuses the stale pointer as live Variant state.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing root obligation is the post-free null assignment on `dst->data`. The vulnerable helper frees the unwrapped body buffer and leaves `dst->data` dangling; the fixed helper satisfies the same source-level predicate by storing `NULL` immediately after the free.

nodes.state: Failure cleanup re-enters `Variant_clear()` with `p->data` still equal to the heap pointer freed on the unwrap helper's error path, so the scalar-Variant cleanup path remains armed on stale state.
`UA_Array_delete()` receives the same stale pointer as its `p` argument and passes it to `UA_free()`, producing the second free that AddressSanitizer reports.

edges.relation: The same `dst->data` pointer left non-NULL after the error-path free later reappears as `p->data` when `UA_decodeJson()` failure cleanup re-enters `Variant_clear()` on the same `UA_Variant`.
`Variant_clear()` forwards its stale `p->data` field unchanged into `UA_Array_delete(p, ...)`, so the sink's free argument is exactly the dangling Variant data pointer.
